_comment: design-lint.py prefix allowlist (symbol check). Every entry must carry a
reason. These are tokens that MATCH the stable-ID regex but are not design
namespaces — encodings, standards, model names, and the audit-sweep
severity row numbering (HIGH-1/MED-3/LOW-2). Removing an entry makes its
occurrences findings again. A doc-scoped alternative is the inline pragma:

prefixes.UTF: UTF-8 — encoding token, not a namespace
prefixes.GPT: GPT-4 / GPT-5 — LLM model names quoted in prose
prefixes.HIGH: audit-sweep severity row numbering (HIGH-n), local to the sweep banners, not a stable namespace
